object.attr: A heart rate sensor problem is not a reason to lose a recording. The BLE link reports a Bluetooth unavailable error in all three cases, and the location and timer jobs run separately from the heart rate job. Readings from an ANT+ heart rate sensor are not affected. Basis: as implemented.
object.description: When the device has no Bluetooth adapter, the Bluetooth adapter is switched off or the Bluetooth connect permission is not granted, the app shall continue the session without readings from a BLE heart rate sensor.
